title: SG-1.2 Write pure grid-to-pixels and sprite-sheet functions
summary: Pure functions turn a palette-indexed grid into RGBA and lay frames out into a sprite sheet, with unit tests.
description: Context: game/frontend/src/lib/palette.ts exports PALETTE, a 48-entry list of '#rrggbb' strings. No art code exists yet. Desired behaviour: pure, deterministic functions convert a palette-indexed grid to RGBA bytes and arrange frames into a sheet. Expected result: unit tests check width, height, frame count, palette-only colours and that an out-of-range index throws. Why: SG-1.3 builds the PNG script on top of these functions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a grid of palette indices, when gridToRgba runs, then it returns RGBA bytes of width*height*4 whose colours all come from PALETTE.
Given an index outside the palette, when gridToRgba runs, then it throws.
Given N equal-size frames, when buildSpriteSheet runs, then width, height and frameCount describe the sheet and every pixel colour is in PALETTE.

out_of_scope: PNG writing script and manifest update (SG-1.3)
New rooms, story content, backend, audio, deployment, repository clean-up

technical_constraints: Phaser stays on 3.90.x; React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Radix, Zustand stay.
Shared palette of at most 48 colours defined once in src/lib/palette.ts; reuse it, do not redefine colours.
All art is generated in-repo and deterministically; no downloaded art or CDN.
Tests are unit tests with all dependencies mocked.
definition_of_done: Both requirements are met and their Verify units pass.
non_functional: Functions are pure and deterministic: identical input gives identical bytes.
